claim: Under the preregistered scope of N1.0, U1 acquired by experience an association between a retained historical trace and a later action. With an equivalent present observation and learning frozen, that history functionally modulated the decision; interrupting its read or decoupling it from the real history reduced the appropriate behaviour.
claim_does_not_assert: a general cognitive degree of freedom

three_claims_kept_apart.B_EXPRESSION: frozen U1 uses tau to choose under identical O
three_claims_kept_apart.C_CAUSAL_DEPENDENCE: lesion and shuffle degrade that relation

apparatus_normalization.applied: after learn, before the next observation

budget.derivation: the pilot's own totals, read from its run: 8x64 acquisition decisions and 4x32 evaluation ones

learner.initialization: memory EMPTY, Q empty, ties by a dedicated draw
learner.not_optimised: no grid search, no selection on confirmatory data

N.name: NAIVE
N.purpose: shows behaviourally that no mapping is present before experience; CF8 already showed it structurally

B.name: MEMORY_READ_LESION
B.intervention: the token keeps being written; the policy cannot consume its retained value

C.name: HISTORY_SHUFFLED
C.intervention: a sealed deterministic permutation replaces the token the policy reads; world, Q, observations and consequences untouched

reserve_seed_rule: A seed is replaced ONLY when the GENERATED WORLD makes it unevaluable — its evaluation contains a single history class, so balanced accuracy has no second term. Marked SEED_NOT_EVALUABLE and replaced by the next sealed reserve seed, in order. Never replaced because the agent did badly, and every replacement is recorded.

primary.balanced_functional_accuracy: BA = [P(correct|H0) + P(correct|H1)] / 2, because the H0/H1 split is not exactly even; chance is 0.5
primary.signed_branch: B_s = P(UP|H_up) - P(UP|H_down); +1 perfect, 0 no governance, -1 fully inverted. The absolute value is reported too but is not the diagnostic of direction

inference.unit: TRAINING SEED / TRAINED SNAPSHOT — decisions from one learner are not independent replicates
inference.procedure: paired bootstrap over seed-level deltas, 10000 resamples, 95% interval and lower bound
inference.conjunction: intersection-union: all three contrasts must clear their bound; no retrospective selection of the favourable one

structural.decision_parity: set(decision_ids) identical across A, B and C — not merely equal counts
structural.evaluation_freeze: theta digest identical before and after every evaluation, exact
structural.same_present: every comparable decision group collapses to ONE obs_hash holding both histories
structural.exposure: both history classes present in acquisition and in evaluation for every seed
structural.seed_evaluability: decided from GeneratedWorld.stations BEFORE any agent runs: both history classes must be present in the acquisition world and in the evaluation world
structural.shuffle_strength: P(policy_token == actual_history) <= 0.75, reported against the chance floor (n0^2 + n1^2)/n^2. Preserving the marginals is not enough: a permutation leaving most tokens in place would make arm C nearly arm A with noise

BA_A.derivation: halfway between the chance floor 0.5 and the ceiling 1.0: the mapping has to be more present than absent

lesion_loss.derivation: PREREGISTERED MINIMUM RELEVANT CAUSAL EFFECT: ten points of balanced accuracy, a fifth of the functional range between chance (0.5) and solution (1.0). Declared as a bar we are willing to call causal, NOT derived from the size we expect

per_history.derivation: chance in the binary task, bounded per class rather than point-estimated

invalidation_rules: observation leakage at a comparable decision
any instrument gate failing on the sealed commit
code differing from the sealed hashes
snapshot inequality across A, B and C
history_id reaching the organism by any route
feedback taken from anything but consequence_t1.energy_delta
a missing history class in a seed's evaluation
any protocol deviation not registered before the run

pilot_diagnostics.scope: a fact about the pilot's snapshots, not a general property of U1
pilot_diagnostics.evidence: the same reproduced snapshot 785eef13841936be gives acc 0.9297 / BA 0.9274 / signed_branch +0.8548 at epsilon 0.2 and acc 1.0000 / BA 1.0000 / signed_branch +1.0000 at epsilon 0; the prediction under the exploration hypothesis is 0.90

supersedes.reason: statistical and procedural corrections made while no confirmatory seed had been spent

analysis.interval_method: paired bootstrap over seed-level deltas; the DECISION rule uses the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound (the 5th percentile of the resampled distribution). A two-sided 95% interval (2.5th, 97.5th) is reported alongside and is descriptive only
analysis.conjunction: intersection-union: acquisition, lesion and shuffle must ALL clear their bound. No retrospective selection of the favourable contrast
analysis.per_class: accuracy_H0 and accuracy_H1 are computed PER SEED and bootstrapped between seeds; BOTH lower bounds must exceed 0.5. Two point estimates above chance would let a class pass on noise
analysis.signed_branch: reported for direction, NOT a fourth confirmatory contrast: in a binary task it re-expresses the separation balanced accuracy carries
